sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 256x192, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=40 mK; optical: 1/2.7in 4MP CMOS
features: bi-spectrum thermal + 4MP visible hybrid speed dome (Eureka / Lite series) with radiometric temperature measurement
temperature measurement -20 to 550 C; up to 12 measurement rules simultaneously
fixed visible lens (4 / 8 / 12 mm); IR illumination distance >=50 m
AI: tripwire, intrusion, call detection, smoking detection, heat detection, temperature monitoring, hot/cold spot tracking
release_notes: Lite-series compact thermal + 4MP visible hybrid speed dome with a 256x192 radiometric detector measuring -20 to 550 C for short-distance perimeter and temperature monitoring.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2).
